children: Publicis Groupe's third-quarter update is likely to show the company's top-line growth is trending in line with its full-year outlook, Bernstein analysts say in a research note. The French advertising company is expected to report organic net revenue growth of 4.9%, above consensus estimates of 4.8% and in line with its guidance of between 4.5% and 5% for the year as a whole, according to Bernstein. Publicis continues to benefit from new business momentum and its connected media segment remains the group's growth engine, the analysts say. The fact that Publicis doesn't have to defend any major accounts in upcoming budget reviews from big advertisers also plays in its favor, the analysts add. Shares rise 0.3%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
